# filename: assign_format_and_find_oldest_bluray.py
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, skiprows=2)
formats = ['DVD','Blu-Ray','VHS']
df['Format'] = df['Title'].where(df['Title'].isin(formats)).ffill()
# Exclude the header rows themselves
content_df = df[~df['Title'].isin(formats)].copy()
content_df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(content_df['Year'], errors='coerce')
bluray_df = content_df[content_df['Format'] == 'Blu-Ray'].dropna(subset=['Year']).copy()
bluray_sorted = bluray_df.sort_values('Year')
print('Blu-Ray entries sorted by year:')
print(bluray_sorted[['Title','Year']])
print('Oldest Blu-Ray title:', bluray_sorted.iloc[0]['Title'])
